notes: Guide arrows on the ground are now soft shadows by day and spots of light at night, and they circle stasis pods to show how to tow them.
A new Help button at the bottom of the screen shows your next step and a log of the level so far, with Restart and Skip level. A skipped level earns no stars, and you can come back and win it later.
Hire pads that need the job done by hand first now show as locked and say so, instead of staying hidden.
